name: Watercolor Storybook: Location Exterior
description: Image preset for a location exterior in the Watercolor Storybook look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an exterior establishing shot. Name the location's defining structure, surroundings, time of day, and weather from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: wide exterior establishing view of the location, clear foreground, midground and background, a sense of scale from a figure or doorway, watercolour picture-book illustration, soft pencil line, loose washes that bleed past the line, visible paper texture, gentle rounded shapes, pastel palette, soft daylight, white paper showing through the highlights
negative_prompt: photorealistic, 3d render, harsh black outlines, neon colours, dark horror mood, text, watermark
